overview.heading: What is on the Wetherspoons sunday roast menu?
overview.body:
The Sunday roast selection comprises [Roast Beef](/sunday-roasts/roast-beef), [Roast Chicken Breast](/sunday-roasts/roast-chicken-breast), [Roast Pork](/sunday-roasts/roast-pork), Vegetarian Wellington and Vegan Wellington. The meat choices differ in both format and flavour: beef comes in slices with a savoury character, chicken is a breast with a milder flavour and accompanying gravy, while pork is described as slow-roasted slices with crispy crackling. Choose between them by the centrepiece you actually want, rather than assuming every roast is interchangeable.

The meat-free options have distinct fillings. Vegetarian Wellington contains mushrooms, brie and cranberries, combining earthy, creamy and sweet elements. Vegan Wellington uses a vegetable-and-pulse filling in vegan pastry. The brie makes the vegetarian version a different proposition from the vegan one, so the names should not be treated as alternative labels for the same dish.

overview.heading: How do the roast portions and formats differ?
overview.body:
The confirmed differences concern format, not measured portion size: Roast Beef and Roast Pork are sliced meat dishes, Roast Chicken Breast uses a breast, and the wellingtons are filled centrepieces. No portion weights or complete side lists are supplied. Although the descriptions present these as hearty roast dinners, they do not establish that one plate contains more food than another.

Roast Pork specifically mentions crackling, while Roast Chicken Breast mentions gravy. Vegan Wellington is described with flaky vegan pastry, and Vegetarian Wellington centres on mushrooms, brie and cranberries. If accompaniments matter as much as the main ingredient, ask for the complete serving details. This is particularly useful when choosing for someone who wants a particular side or needs to avoid an ingredient in the gravy or trimmings.

overview.body:
An included drink or seasonal rotation is not confirmed for the Sunday roast selection. The supplied list names Roast Beef, Roast Chicken Breast, Roast Pork and the vegetarian and vegan wellingtons; it does not identify additional seasonal dishes. Treat those named options as the basis for comparison, then check what your chosen pub can serve that Sunday.

Curry Club traditionally falls on Thursday and [Steak Club](/steak-club) on Tuesday at participating pubs, often with a drink included. Those arrangements do not establish a Sunday roast deal. Before ordering, ask whether the displayed roast price covers food alone or food plus an eligible drink. If a local menu shows a different or temporary roast option, check its description, dietary label and price separately rather than assuming it matches one of these dishes.
